title: Supply-chain PR-image scan is cancelled at its job timeout during a slow package-mirror build
symptoms: Supply Chain Scan image-scans job cancelled after exhausting its 40-minute timeout
PR-image scan stops during a container image build rather than at a Grype High/Critical finding
Slow apt index or package downloads dominate a build-tools image layer
conditions: The failure is a job-level timeout or cancellation in a PR-image scan job, not a scanner finding: the build-tools build may complete and Grype may run before the job is cancelled during the next image build
Older workflow code built all nine PR images sequentially in one job sharing a single 40-minute budget
Current code runs three PR-image shards (build-tools + enclave-agent, agent, and six service images), each with a 60-minute budget; published-image CVE and license scans keep 40 minutes
enclave-agent must share a shard with build-tools because it consumes the exact locally built base image
A slow mirror, a cache-export failure and a blocking High/Critical vulnerability are different causes that must be classified from the failing step
rootCause: Package retrieval from a slow mirror consumed most of one shared 40-minute budget (the originating PR measured a 36-minute build-tools layer), so the remaining image builds were cancelled. Sharding gives each independent set of images its own budget and runner; it does not make the upstream mirror faster, and no hosted run has yet shown the 60-minute budgets are sufficient under a slow mirror.

probe.expect: The command checks workflow topology only: current source lists pr-toolchain, pr-agent and pr-services with a 60-minute timeout. From existing run metadata and bounded build-log timing evidence, confirm cancellation at the job limit and distinguish package retrieval, compilation, cache export and Grype execution within the combined build-and-scan step. Match the slow-mirror cause only when apt index or package-download timings show that retrieval consumed most of the shared 40-minute budget. Cancellation without a Grype finding alone is insufficient; absent timing or cancellation-reason evidence leaves the cause unknown.

action: Use source with the sharded PR-image matrix. Fix the classified step; do not disable or downgrade the blocking High/Critical gate, merge shards in a way that separates enclave-agent from build-tools, ignore cache-export failures, or raise one shared timeout to absorb all builds. Hosted acceptance remains separate; a repeat timeout at 60 minutes is new evidence, not covered by this finding.
